stem: Which breakthrough did Hiram Rhodes Revels accomplish during Reconstruction?

options.label: F
options.text: He became the first African American to publish literature.

options.label: G
options.text: He became the first African American to build wealth as a carpetbagger.

options.label: H
options.text: He became the first African American to win a seat in the U.S. Congress.

options.label: J
options.text: He became the first African American soldier to serve in an integrated Union Army unit.
